WITH matched_orders AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    o.recordvault,
    o.timespan
  FROM orders o
  INNER JOIN riskandmargin r ON o.recordvault = r.ordervault
),
counts_per_tif AS (
  SELECT
    timespan,
    COUNT(*) as order_count
  FROM matched_orders
  GROUP BY timespan
),
totals AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(order_count) as total_orders,
    COUNT(*) as num_tif_values
  FROM counts_per_tif
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT
    c.timespan,
    c.order_count,
    c.order_count::NUMERIC / t.total_orders as share,
    1.0::NUMERIC / t.num_tif_values as avg_share
  FROM counts_per_tif c
  CROSS JOIN totals t
)
SELECT
  timespan,
  order_count,
  share,
  share - avg_share as share_diff
FROM with_shares
ORDER BY timespan;

assumptions.assumption: Average share is 1/(number of TIF values), representing the share each TIF would have under uniform distribution. This equals the arithmetic mean of all individual shares (since shares sum to 1.0).
